jobs.title: Project Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
:
**GFT** is seeking a **Project Environmental Scientist** to join our growing Environmental Practice! This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring regular attendance at either our **Berkeley, CA or Roseville, CA** offices.  

GFT’s Environmental team delivers integrated planning, permitting, and compliance solutions that support infrastructure development across North America. With more than 140 professionals in 22 offices, the team guides clients through NEPA and permitting processes, ecological and regulatory assessments, and environmental remediation efforts. Their expertise spans transportation, power, water, and facilities markets — working alongside agencies at federal, state, and local levels. From stream restoration to complex regulatory requirements and advance critical infrastructure projects. **What you’ll be challenged to do:**
This is an excellent career opportunity for an experienced, motivated Project Environmental Scientist who is ready to take the next step in their career. We are looking for someone how combines strong technical permitting expertise – a professional that enjoys doing the work, working directly with clients and regulatory agencies and helping to building a growing environmental practice.
The successful candidate will have strong working knowledge of California and federal environmental permitting requirements, particularly as they apply to transportation, water and power projects. This individual will lead and prepare permit applications and technical documentation, coordinate with regulatory agencies, manage permitting assignments and support projects through planning and through design and construction. **In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:*** Lead and support natural resource analysis and environmental permitting for transportation, water, and other infrastructure projects throughout California.
* Develop permitting strategies and identify federal, state, and local regulatory requirements during project planning, CEQA/NEPA and design.
* Prepare and manage permit applications and supporting technical documentation, including Clean Water Act Sections 404 and 401, California Fish and Game Code Section 1600 Lake and Streambed Alteration Agreements, and other applicable federal, state, and local permits and approvals.
* Coordinate directly with regulatory agencies, including the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Regional Water Quality Control Boards, California Department of Fish and Wildlife, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, NOAA Fisheries, and other agencies as appropriate.
* Conduct wetland delineations, jurisdictional assessments, biological field studies, and other technical investigations necessary to support project permitting as well as CEQA/NEPA analysis.
* Author and review technical reports, CEQA/NEPA analysis, permit applications, environmental commitments, mitigation plans, and related environmental deliverables.
* Work closely with engineering and design teams to identify natural resource and permitting constraints, develop practical avoidance and minimization measures, and incorporate environmental requirements into project design and construction.
* Support environmental compliance during construction, including implementation and tracking of permit conditions and mitigation commitments.
* Manage environmental permitting assignments, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing, deliverables, and client communications.
* Contribute to and increasingly lead environmental components of proposals, interviews, scopes of work, and cost estimates.
* Contribute to the continued development of GFT’s California Environmental Practice.


:
**What you will bring to our firm:*** Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, biology, ecology, the physical sciences, or closely related field.
* Approximately 5\-8 years of progressively responsible experience, with significant experience delivering natural resources and permitting services for infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience preparing and managing environmental permits for projects in California.
* Strong working knowledge of applicable federal and California environmental regulations.
* Experience working with and developing relationships with regulatory agencies such as USACE, CDFW, RWQCB, USFWA and/or NOAA Fisheries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-starter, able to complete tasks with minimal supervision and direction.
* Willingness to travel and execute work in a variety of settings and environmental conditions (heat, cold, rain, etc.).
* Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal skills to work effectively with others and achieve results.
* Demonstrated agility working with multi\-disciplined infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated professional judgment, consistency, strong attention to detail, and background of high\-quality work products.
* Ability to prepare and deliver presentations and lead meetings, when needed.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and interest in helping grow a developing California environmental practice.

**What we prefer you bring:*** A Master’s degree in environmental science, biology, ecology or a closely related field.
* Established relationships with California transportation agencies, water agencies, municipalities, regulatory agencies, or other infrastructure clients.
* Experience with Caltrans, local transportation agencies, passenger rail/transit agencies, water districts, utilities, or similar California public\-sector clients.
* GIS experience.
* Relevant professional certifications or specialized permitting/natural\-resource credentials.

### **Compensation:**


The salary range for this role is **$95,000 \- $135,000**; Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location.### **Featured Benefits:**

* Hybrid (in\-person and remote) work environment.
* Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental,

jobs.description:
**About Us**SoCalGas, the nation's largest gas distribution utility, is dedicated to providing safe, reliable, and affordable energy to over 21 million Southern California customers. Through innovation, collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to the needs of our communities we proudly uphold our mindset of “Glad to be of Service” and provide exceptional customer service today and ready to meet California's energy needs with innovative solutions for tomorrow.
As an employee of SoCalGas, you will support our core values to do the right thing, champion people, and shape the future. You will play a pivotal role in the energy transition initiatives, supporting our mission: Safe, reliable, and affordable energy delivery today. Ready for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting top talent and fostering a diverse workforce that reflects the vibrant communities we serve.
As an employee of SoCalGas, you'll enjoy a competitive compensation plan, upward mobility opportunities and the ability to find a true work life balance. Discover the rewards of joining SoCalGas by exploring our website: Our Mission; Sustainability, In the Community, and Employee Benefits. Join SoCalGas today and become a vital part of a team that is driving innovation, championing community needs, and shaping the future of energy in California.
**Primary Purpose**
Applies specialized knowledge to lead functional projects and secure cost‑effective compliance. Independently develops innovative approaches and engages regulators on technical matters.
**Team \& Role Context**
The Environmental Science Senior II is a senior level role on a team of environmental professionals in the Environmental Services Department at SoCalGas. The team's primary role is to support Company infrastructure projects with environmental and regulatory permitting and entitlements, which may include CEQA and NEPA environmental review. Teamwork and cross functional collaboration are central to the team's approach, working closely with project managers, technical experts, stakeholder engagement leads, agency partners and the public. This team is involved with project feasibility studies, permit application preparation and submittal, agency coordination and public outreach, environmental review and construction compliance monitoring. Working independently with guidance only in the most complex situations, the Senior II leads the environmental evaluation and permitting activities of complex projects and possesses specialized knowledge of environmental science, including one or more environmental disciplines, such as land use planning, biology, archaeology, air quality or related fields.  

**Duties and Responsibilities**
* Act as the environmental lead and coordinate studies, review documents, and implement compliance measures \& training. Identify / address environmental requirements including federal \& state regulatory requirements, permit conditions, avoidance \& mitigation measures related to infrastructure projects
* Provide technical leadership for environmental documents, which may include CEQA/NEPA, permit applications, and project deliverables.
* Coordinate and/or participate in field activities, including construction compliance monitoring and environmental inspections. Prepare permitting schedules, integrates with project plans, evaluates risks, and communicates with stakeholders and management.
* Executes programs to ensure regulatory obligations are met while optimizing costs and minimizing operational disruptions.
* Provides technical expertise in leveraging GIS data for spatial analysis and visualization, ensuring adherence to industry standards and best practices.
* Monitors day\-to\-day environmental compliance programs including waste management, water pollution control, spill plans and response, emergency planning and release reporting, and other applicable environmental requirements.
* Reviews environmental record keeping and reporting including data review and analysis, report preparation, report filing, agency notification, permit application review and input to regulatory comments.
* Leads the development of environmental processes, procedures and environmental awareness training.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
Requirements:
**Education**
* Required: a 4 year degree in a relevant field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Preferred: Degree, preferably in environmental studies/science, urban/environmental planning, biology, anthropology/archaeology, geography, engineering, or related field. Master's degree is preferred.

  


  

**Experience**
* Required: 8 years of related experience.
* Preferred: Experience with project scope analysis to determine applicable regulations and permits; development of permitting strategies; management and review of technical reports, permit applications, and environmental documents (e.g., CEQA, NEPA); and development of environmental schedules is preferred.

  


  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
* Required: Ability to anticipate emerging environmental risks and trends.
* Required: Ability to balance scientific rigor with regulatory and business constraints.
* Required: Ability to operate autonomously on high\-visibility scientific initiatives.
* Required: Knowledge of advanced environmental science methodologies and assessment frameworks.
* Required: Knowledge of cumulative impact analysis and risk evaluation techniques.
* Required: Skill in leading complex investigations, modeling efforts, or impact assessments.
* Required: Skill in synthesizing diverse datasets to support environmental decision\-making.
* Preferred: Strong project management skills with the ability to review complex problems and propose innovative solutions. Experience managing requirements of complex projects including design requirements, schedule, budget, and differing stakeholder interests. Capable of coordinating with diverse groups of stakeholders. jobs.title: Air Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
To Apply: Please submit a letter of interest, resume, references, and a recent writing sample in which the candidate was the sole author to humanresources@aspeneg.com. The subject line must state, “Air Quality Specialist – \[NAME].”

  


### **Location: California**


Aspen Environmental Group is seeking an experienced and motivated Air Quality Specialist to support projects focused primarily on CEQA/NEPA analysis, air quality impact modeling, and greenhouse gas emissions inventory evaluations. The Air Quality Specialist will work as part of a multidisciplinary environmental team and collaborate with other recognized experts.


Aspen’s Air Quality \& Climate Services group supports environmental compliance projects, including Air Quality Impact Analysis, Compliance Audit Evaluations, and Climate Change Analysis. Learn more about our Air Quality \& Climate Services at: https://www.aspeneg.com/service/air\-quality\-climate\-services

#### **Required Education and Experience**

* B.S. degree in Engineering (Environmental, Civil, Chemical, or Mechanical) or Science (Environmental, Atmospheric, Meteorological, Chemistry, Toxicology, or Data Science) required; M.S. and/or P.E. a plus.
* Minimum of 5 to 8 years of direct consulting, public agency, or industry experience in air quality\-related aspects of CEQA/NEPA services.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Write environmental impact analyses, assess regulatory compliance, and perform regulatory applicability evaluations.
* Write evaluations of complex air quality impact analyses, compliance, and permitting situations.
* Perform multiple tasks within scope, budget, and schedule expectations and ensure quality standards on project deliverables.
* Communicate environmental standards to management and/or clients.
* Interact and maintain successful relationships with clients, in\-house project managers and staff, and subcontractors.
* Work independently and with teams to complete assignments.
* Deliver assignments on time and within the allotted budget.
* Engage in business development efforts.

#### **Qualifications for Success**

* Subject matter expertise in air pollution principles, air quality impact analysis methodologies, greenhouse gas emissions inventory development and management strategies, and California policies and regulatory programs of local air districts and the state.
* Actively stays informed regarding the changing regulatory landscape in California.
* Experience with AERMOD dispersion modeling and related software for ambient impact evaluation and health risk assessment.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining a strong focus on environmental protection, health, safety, quality, budget, and schedule.
* Highly developed organizational skills, with attention to both the big picture and detail, to meet competing deadlines and demands.
* Excellent technical writing and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to succeed in a fast\-paced consulting environment, handle multiple project assignments, and meet strict deadlines.
* Success in new business development preferred.
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, and basic computer skills required.

#### **Compensation**


The pay range for this role is $97,000 \- $130,000 commensurate with experience.

#### **To Apply**


Please submit a letter of interest, resume, references, and a recent writing sample in which the candidate was the sole author to humanresources@aspeneg.com. The subject line must state, “Air Quality Specialist – \[NAME].”

jobs.company: Bay Area Air Quality Management District
jobs.title: Senior Air Quality Specialist (Regulatory Development)
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


The Bay Area Air Quality Management District (Air District) is a regional government agency, committed to achieving clean air to protect the public's health and the environment. The Air District accomplishes this goal through regulation of industrial facilities and various outreach and incentive programs designed to encourage clean air choices.
  

  

The Air District's jurisdiction encompasses all of seven counties \- Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara and Napa, and portions of two others \- southwestern Solano and southern Sonoma.
  

  

The Air District is currently accepting applications for the position of Senior Air Quality Specialist in the Regulatory Development Division. This is an open recruitment for one (1\) full\-time, represented position.


**About the Position**


The Senior Air Quality Specialist will serve as lead in reviewing and drafting regulatory language for various air quality rule programs; work closely with professional and technical staff to interpret complex scientific research and economic and environmental analyses and technical work for developing regulations to control air pollutants (including those contributing to climate change and contributing to localize air quality impacts in overburdened communities).


Develop and implement cost effectiveness and incremental cost effectiveness calculations for a wide variety of sources in industry with a variety of control options; analyze emissions inventories to determine baseline emissions and reduction estimates for rules under development; brief District executives and present at workshops, committee and board meetings; work closely with the Community Engagement Section staff and other Air District divisions to strengthen partnerships with key community stakeholders; perform related work as assigned.


The Regulatory Development Division works with all levels of the Air District, including staff, management, executives, and Board members in developing and modifying Air District rules to provide emissions reductions to improve air quality both regionally and at the neighborhood level and protect the climate. Click here to learn more about the Regulatory Development Division and the rule development process.  

  

  

**Definition**


Under general direction, provides lead direction and performs complex assignments related to the administration, development, and implementation of air quality programs.


**Distinguishing Characteristics**


This is the advanced lead level in the air quality specialist series. Incumbents provide lead direction and are assigned complex air quality program assignments that require considerable technical knowledge and use of independent judgement. Incumbents develop and provide in\-depth training and technical guidance to employees.


This class is distinguished from Principal Air Quality Specialist in that the latter is responsible for providing subject matter expertise and for developing new programs and handling the most difficult, sensitive, novel, or critical projects. This class is distinguished from Supervising Air Quality Specialist, in that the latter assigns, supervises, reviews and evaluates the work of assigned staff on a continuing basis.


**Hybrid Work Schedule**
  

A schedule that meets the needs of our staff, department operations, and the communities we serve may be available depending on the assignment. This position is a field and office position.
  

  

**About the Air District**
  

Bay Area Air District is a regional government agency, committed to achieving clean air to protect the public's health and the environment. The Air District accomplishes this goal through regulation of industrial facilities and various outreach and incentive programs designed to encourage clean air choices. The Air District's jurisdiction encompasses all of seven counties \- Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara and Napa, and portions of two others \- southwestern Solano and southern Sonoma.
  

  

At the Air District, we take pride in our commitment to fostering a workplace that values diversity and promotes cultural awareness. We prioritize employee engagement by providing a collaborative and inclusive environment that encourages active participation and open dialogue. Additionally, we believe in pay equity and strive to create an equitable compensation structure. With a strong emphasis on work\-life balance, we understand the importance of supporting our employees' well\-being both inside and outside the workplace. Join us in a dynamic and inclusive culture where your contributions are celebrated and your growth is nurtured.
  

  

The Air District recognizes and values the contributions of every employee and works to sustain an environment where everyone is respected. We incorporate the principles of diversity, equity and inclusion within our decision\-making strategies, policies, procedures, regulations, funding initiatives, public outreach, planning, and hiring.  

  

  

  

**Examples of Duties for this Position**
----------------------------------------


*The following duties are typical for jobs in the class. They are for illustrative purposes only and do not reflect the full scope of job duties.*


Provides lead direction, coordination, training and work review to staff on routine, continuing, or well\-defined tasks.


Provides lead review on complex regulatory audits, field investigations, and studies.


Evaluates, develops, and revises existing air quality policies and programs. Researches technical feasibility and new control proposals for new or revised rules.


Leads the development, review, and tracking of approval processes for new and revised rules and regulations, policies and procedures for various programs.


Reviews and analyzes complex cases and rules for compliance with applicable guidelines. Conducts inquiries, researches and compiles data and other pert

jobs.description:
Are you driven to grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact? At Apex, we're building more than a consulting and engineering firm—we're creating a place where your career accelerates, your contributions matter, and your potential is fully realized. We believe your growth is our growth, which is why we invest in your development at every stage of your career. Here, you'll work on projects that shape communities, protect the environment, and create lasting impact, all while being empowered with the autonomy and flexibility to do your best work.  

  

Fueled by high\-quality delivery, exceptional client retention, and strategic acquisitions, Apex Companies continues to rank among the fastest\-growing firms in the AEC industry, recently recognized by the Zweig Group for our industry\-leading growth. Our success is grounded in strong leadership, a collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.  

  

As we continue to expand, we're looking for high\-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. When we succeed together, we share in that success. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

 **Environmental Scientist/Industrial Hygienist**


*Locations: Los Angeles or Orange County \| \~50% field / 50% remote*



Apex is seeking an environmental professional with experience in industrial hygiene to perform asbestos, lead\-paint, mold/moisture intrusion, exposure assessment, abatement monitoring, and related industrial hygiene and EHS compliance projects across Southern California.

  

**Employee Benefits**  

This role offers competitive compensation and a robust benefits package, a balanced mix of fieldwork and report writing, company sponsorship for professional and vocational training, work from home opportunity, collaboration with other industrial hygiene, EHS and other experts, and continued professional development and growth afforded by a rapidly growing national environmental consulting company.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Perform asbestos, lead\-based paint (LBP), and microbial/moisture intrusion assessments, along with abatement oversight, with an approximate 50/50 split between field and office work
* Conduct safety and compliance assessments in accordance with regulatory standards and client requirements
* Support additional environmental services through cross\-training, including:
	+ Exposure assessments
	+ Workplace safety evaluations
	+ Stormwater compliance inspections
	+ Soil and groundwater sampling
	+ Noise and air monitoring
	+ Aboveground Storage Tank (AST) inspections
* Execute work in alignment with project work plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and direction from project managers
* Manage scheduling and logistics across all project phases, from coordination and fieldwork through reporting
* Prepare clear, accurate, and technically sound client\-ready reports using project\-specific templates
* Collaborate with internal teams to support project delivery and ongoing professional development
* Maintain and proactively pursue relevant certifications, including 40\-Hour HAZWOPER, CAC, and/or CSST


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of professional experience conducting asbestos surveys and mold/moisture intrusion inspections as an AHERA\-accredited inspector (in any state)
* Current AHERA certification required
* California Certified Asbestos Consultant (CAC) and/or Certified Site Surveillance Technician (CSST) preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, Microbiology, or a related field


**What We're Looking For**


* Self\-motivated and dependable professional who can work effectively with limited supervision
* Strong technical writing and critical thinking skills
* Solid analytical and math skills for interpreting laboratory data and preparing reports
* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate in a team\-oriented environment
* Physically capable of performing fieldwork and comfortable working in both field and office settings
* Commitment to safety and a strong understanding of safe work practices
* Interest in growing within industrial hygiene and expanding into broader environmental consulting services


**Why you'll love working for us:**


* Company\-subsidized medical and dental.
* Company\-paid life, short, and long\-term disability.
* 401k match, tuition assistance, and more.
* Cross\-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.
* Performance\-based bonuses or other incentives.
* Working with the best and brightest in the industry.
* 2,000\+ employee national firm with 70\+ locations across the US.

jobs.description:
**CAREER DESCRIPTION**
----------------------


**HAZARDOUS MATERIALS SPECIALIST II**


*Salary may be negotiable within the range listed above, based on position requirements and successful candidate's qualifications, subject to appropriate authorization.*


**OPEN TO THE PUBLIC**
  

This recruitment will establish an open eligible list that will be used to fill current and future **Hazardous Material Specialist II** positions. The eligible list established may also be used to fill positions in similar and/or lower classifications throughout the County of Orange.


**DEADLINE TO APPLY**
  

This recruitment will be open for a minimum of five (5\) business days and will close on **Thursday,** **September** **24, 2026, at 11:59 P.M. (PST).**


**HEALTH CARE AGENCY**
The County of Orange, Health Care Agency (HCA) is a dynamic organization dedicated to creating and supporting an environment that promotes the achievement of optimal individual, family and community health. Under the leadership of the Agency Director, a dynamic executive team with an organizational structure comprised of five (5\) service areas \- Administrative Services, Behavioral Health Services, Correctional Health Services, Public Health Services, and Specialized Medical Health Services \- is committed to meeting the health needs of the diverse Orange County community.


**ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH DIVISION**


The **Environmental Health Division (EH)** is comprised of various programs aimed toward protecting the health and safety of Orange County residents and visitors from harmful conditions in the environment. **SUMMARY OF POSITION**
The Environmental Health Bureau sits within the County of Monterey’s Department of Health and consists of seven major environmental health regulatory programs: Healthy Housing Services, Consumer Health Protection Services, Drinking Water Protection Services, Environmental Health Review (Land Use) Services, Hazardous Materials Management Services, Recycling and Resource Recovery Services, and Solid Waste Management Services.  

  

The Environmental Health Bureau is seeking to fill one full\-time Environmental Health Specialist IV (EHS IV) for the Healthy Housing Services program.  

  

The Healthy Housing Services program is responsible for ensuring safe and healthy living environments through the inspection and enforcement of state and local housing regulations for residential rental housing, employee housing, detention facilities, and other regulated facilities. **TEMP ASSOCIATE CREATIVE DIRECTOR – OLEHENRIKSEN**

**Reports to: Senior Creative Director, Design**

**ABOUT KENDO**

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco\-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy \- Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.


Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market\-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct\-to\-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:


* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone’s voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It’s our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever\- constant, and agility is our strength.
Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.  
* 

The salary range for this temp position is $61\.00 \- $73\.00 per hour. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in\-office, with Monday and Friday remote.  



The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.  



**SUMMARY**

The Temp Creative Director holds the visual creative direction and brand vision specifically for OH, translating the overarching creative strategy into a distinct, consistent aesthetic that is right for that brand. Paired closely with the head of copy, they function as a creative duo: concepting together, briefing the execution layer together, and delivering together. This role understands creative’s role in the current marketing landscape, and is able to concept assets for traditional placements (in\-store, print) as well as native\-to\-platform content (social). They are open to thinking differently and approaching creative content to meet the needs of the moment. They also bring management skills, and manage a team of five designers. This person is both a strong conceptual thinker and a hands\-on maker.  



**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Ole Henriksen creative direction—visual identity, campaign concepting, and brand expression across all touchpoints
* Creative concepting for all Ole campaign moments—major and minor—from initial territory through execution brief
* Art direction for Ole campaign shoots—shot lists, casting direction, set and prop direction in partnership with the Sr. CD
* Collaborates with head of copy—joint concepting, shared briefing, aligned delivery
* Campaign execution quality—ensures all design output across the execution layer meets the creative brief
Direct reports include three designers; provide feedback and creative direction to their work  
* 

**REQUIREMENTS**

* 6\+ years of design and art direction experience, with a strong beauty or lifestyle brand portfolio
* Demonstrated ability to hold a distinct brand visual world and voice across multiple campaign moments
* Demonstrated ability to produce work that resonates on social (Meta, Tiktok, Youtube)
* Strong understanding of native to platform art direction; ability to develop campaigns that are social first
* Experience working in a creative pairing model—knows how to co\-lead with a copy partner
* Strong campaign concepting skills—able to generate original creative territories, not just execute briefs
* Comfortable functioning as both a director and an individual contributor
* Visual merchandising design experience a plus

jobs.title: Chemical Safety Expert for AI Model Safety Audit
jobs.description:
\#\# Description SME Careers is hiring chemists and chemical safety professionals to audit how AI models respond to sensitive questions in the field. Each task gives you a user request and the answers three different models gave to it. You classify the request (benign, dual\-use or adversarial), mark each answer as safe or unsafe and say why, rank the three against each other, and write the answer the model should have given. For dual\-use requests you also note what makes it sensitive, what legitimate purpose it serves, and who should be able to get an answer. The requests are realistic: what synthetic and analytical chemists, toxicologists, industrial hygienists, process safety engineers, regulators and occasionally bad actors actually ask. Some are ordinary professional questions that models wrongly refuse, and catching those matters as much as catching the dangerous ones. \#\# Who we're looking for Synthetic and analytical chemists; toxicologists and pharmacologists; industrial hygienists and chemical safety/process safety professionals; CWC or chemical\-security specialists; hazmat, poison\-control or chemical incident responders; and chemical regulators (EPA, OSHA, HSE, OPCW\-adjacent, or equivalent). Usually a relevant degree plus five or more years of professional experience. Experience with safety data sheets, exposure assessment, incident reports or regulatory review is a strong plus. \#\# Before you apply Open only to citizens or permanent residents of the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and the European Union.

**Description**


**About the role**


We currently have an exciting opportunity for a **Senior Environmental Scientist** to join our **Contaminated Land** team. Our team is experienced in planning and executing environmental site assessment and remediation projects which improve the health and wellbeing of the communities that we live in.


In this role, you’ll provide strategic and practical solutions to clients with a broad range of environmental management challenges under the guidance of an experienced Project Director. Your role will predominantly include interpretation of technical data, preparation of technical reports, and presenting information in a clear and logical manner, with additional opportunities in project management, planning and delivery. You will primarily work on a large fuel facility remediation program, involving complex and unique approaches to site assessment, management and remediation. You will also be involved in varied and interesting projects, ranging from industrial and Defence sites to greenfields and brownfields redevelopments, groundwater hydrogeology investigations, and multi\-disciplinary infrastructure projects.


This position is based in our Melbourne CBD, with flexibility including work from home and staggered hours. We offer strong support for your professional development through mentoring, training, and opportunities to attend industry events and conferences.


**Day to day tasks would involve:**


* Technical leadership including analytical data interpretation, and technical reporting.
* Project management of contaminated land projects including planning and execution of fieldwork, co\-ordination of internal resources, contractor management, budget management and client correspondence.
* Assist with the scope, design and costing of contaminated land and groundwater investigations.
* Provide mentoring and training to graduates and junior professionals throughout the delivery of your projects.
* Lead the preparation of technical reports, focused on presenting information in a clear and logical manner, supported by appropriate interpretation of technical data in accordance with relevant guidelines and legislation.
* Assist in undertaking fieldwork which may involve sampling of environmental media (e.g. soil, groundwater, surface water or soil vapour), undertaking hydrogeological investigations, or supervision of subcontractors conducting works such as drilling, excavation or remediation activities *(This role is predominantly a Project management and technical role; however, some fieldwork and/or field mentoring will be required).*

**To be successful for this role you'll need:**


* Degree in Environmental Science/Engineering, Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Chemistry or related field.
* 5\-15 years’ experience within the field of contaminated land assessment and/or environmental assessment and remediation.
* Strong technical reporting, analytical interpretation, and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience in site supervision, managing site investigations and various sampling methods including soil and groundwater
* Demonstrated project management experience, including verbal communication skills, business acumen to manage projects commercially and to create meaningful relationships with clients
* Valid/current driver’s licence and the ability to travel to sites for field work

**What we offer**

* Learning and Talent Development Programs \- Including Global programmes, external courses, online learning and on\-the\-job learning.
* Mentoring for your own development and the opportunity to mentor others
* Career development and assistance to progress towards technical specialist, reporting or PM roles
* A friendly and supportive team environment, with dedicated and enthusiastic staff committed to producing high\-quality service and deliverables
* Professional Memberships
* Salary Continuance Insurance (SCI)
* Mental Health and Wellbeing Programs
* Service Recognition Awards
* Employee Assistance Program

If this position is of interest, submit your application online.


*Please note that no agency applications will be accepted at this time.*

jobs.title: Senior or Principal Aquatic Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior or Principal Aquatic Scientist \- ( 260000LW )


**Description**


Due to exciting growth in our Australian Environmental Business, we are looking for experienced **Senior or Principal Aquatic Scientists** to work in our passionate Aquatic Ecology Team. We are interested in experienced aquatic scientists that can manage projects, lead surveys, undertake laboratory analysis, and write technical reports. You will also be a part of a broader national group with industry experts across aquatic ecology, marine ecology, terrestrial ecology, and environmental approvals disciplines, who are currently undertaking a range of exciting projects across the Asia Pacific Region.


**About the role**


Our broader Perth Environment and Geoscience Team provides strategic and practical solutions to clients with environmental challenges and comprises more than 100 skilled staff across more than 10 disciplines. We are currently seeking a Senior or Principal Aquatic Scientists with inland waters experience to join our team.


Based in our Perth office, the Aquatic Ecology Team includes a range of leading experts in their field, with demonstrated experience in undertaking comprehensive baseline inland waters surveys, compliance monitoring, specialist analysis and identification (including algae, macrophytes, aquatic invertebrates and fish), technical reporting, and environmental impact assessments. We have a variety of current and upcoming exciting projects spanning across the Pilbara, Central Deserts, Mid\-west, Goldfields, and Southwest regions of Western Australia, sampling waterbodies ranging from freshwater riverine habitats to coastal and offshore marine ecosystems.


**Joining our Aquatic Ecology Team** **would involve the following day to day tasks:**


* Planning, leading and implementing aquatic ecology projects
* Intermittent field work surveying waterbodies in remote areas
* Laboratory analysis and data management
* Preparation of proposals and budgets to meet client and regulatory expectations
* Managing project staff and mentoring junior staff
* Undertaking environmental impact assessment
* Technical report writing to a high scientific standard
* Collaboration across various ecological disciplines (flora and vegetation, terrestrial fauna, marine science, environmental approvals, mine closure, and rehabilitation)

**To be successful for this role you’ll need:**


* Tertiary qualification in Freshwater Ecology / Biology, or Marine Science or equivalent
* Five to 20 years’ professional inland waters experience
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of inland waters concepts
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Well\-developed field and technical skills, including leadership skills
* Exceptional data management, analysis, and report writing skills
* Ability to work well in a team environment
* Taxonomic or specimen identification experience is desirable
* Working knowledge of State and Commonwealth legislation and guidance, relevant to inland waters, is desirable
* Interest in embracing innovation to continually improve our work
* Eligibility to work in Australia with a current C class unrestricted (manual) drivers’ licence

**What we offer**


Along with a competitive salary for commensurate skills and experience, we offer a number of benefits to ensure ongoing professional development and wellbeing including:


* Ability to work with a highly experienced and friendly team, comprising dedicated aquatic scientists with a range of expertise, working on exciting projects
* Penalty rates and time *in lieu* for extended field work in remote locations
* Being part of a broader Environment and Geoscience Team across Australia, with the opportunity to diversify your skill set nationally
* Genuine Flexible Working Arrangements – including work from home opportunities
* Option to purchase up to 4 weeks additional leave
* Learning and Talent Development Programs – including global programmes, online learning and on‑the‑job learning
* Mentoring for your own development and the opportunity to mentor others
* Social and professional clubs within Stantec to enhance connection, interactions and upskilling across Australia
* Professional Registrations and Memberships
* Salary Continuance Insurance (SCI)
* Mental Health and Wellbeing Programs
* Service Recognition Awards
* Employee Referral Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and their immediate family members

**About Stantec**


The Stantec community unites over 34,000 employees working in over 450 locations across six continents. We collaborate across disciplines and industries to bring buildings, energy, resources, water, environmental, transport, and infrastructure projects to life. Our work from initial project concept and planning through design, construction, and commissioning begins at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships.


**Culture**


Stantec is serious about healthy work\-life balance, diversity, inclusion \& equity, indigenous relations, innovation, community engagement, corporate sustainability, and social wellbeing. We have employee groups for women, LGBTQI , neurodiversity, and more! Our employees play sport, fundraise, volunteer, learn, and have fun together.


We are committed to reconciliation and to building respectful relationships with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. We’re better together when different perspectives are welcomed and valued, and we’re committed to a workplace where everyone can belong and thrive. If you need any adjustments to participate in our recruitment process, please let us know

If this position is of interest, submit your application online.

jobs.title: Senior Hazardous Materials Consultant
jobs.description:
* Role with genuine project ownership \& technical responsibility
* Company Vehicle, competitive salary, overtime
* Strong career development with the backing of global Kiwa group


  

Kiwa ELS is a customer\-focused, results\-driven risk management consultancy with offices in Brisbane and Sydney. We deliver hazardous materials, occupational hygiene, environmental and risk management consulting services to clients across Australia.  

  

As part of the Kiwa Group—a global leader in testing, inspection and certification with more than 12,000 professionals across 35\+ countries—we offer the backing of an international organisation while maintaining a strong local presence.  

  

Working alongside our NATA\-accredited laboratory, our Hazardous Materials team provides asbestos, mould and hazardous materials management, assessment and advisory services to an established client base across the construction, facilities management, transport, insurance and government sectors.  

  

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a full\-time Senior Hazardous Materials Consultant to join our Brisbane\-based team.  

  

Approximately 60% of your time will be spent on site across Southeast Queensland, undertaking hazardous materials and occupational hygiene work. The remaining 40% will be office\-based and focused on technical reporting, project management, proposals, quality assurance and supporting the development of other consultants. Occasional travel to regional locations and interstate may also be required.  

  

**What you will be doing**  

* Conduct asbestos, mould and hazardous materials surveys across industrial, commercial and residential properties.
* Undertake clearance inspections and airborne asbestos fibre monitoring associated with asbestos removal work.
* Complete contamination and post\-remediation verification assessments for asbestos, mould, moisture and other contaminants.
* Conduct occupational hygiene surveys and monitoring
* Manage projects, including developing scopes of work, preparing fee proposals, coordinating resources and ensuring project objectives and deadlines are achieved.
* Produce clear, accurate hazardous materials and occupational hygiene reports.
* Undertake technical review and quality assurance of reports prepared by other consultants.
* Provide technical guidance, training and mentoring to less experienced consultants.
* Liaise with clients and stakeholders to understand project requirements and provide practical technical advice.
* Perform laboratory analysis, including fibre counting for airborne asbestos, where required.
* Conduct respirator face fit testing when required.
* Ensure client deliverables are completed accurately and within agreed timeframes.
* Quality Assurance support when required

**Why work with us?**  

* Company vehicle provided.
* Competitive salary \& overtime based on your experience.
* Senior position with genuine project ownership and technical responsibility.
* Opportunity to mentor and support the development of other consultants.
* Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
* Kiwa Rewards, including discounts on shopping, travel, insurance and more.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program.
* Supportive local team with the backing of a global organisation.


  

**Experience and qualifications**  

* 3\+ years’ experience in hazardous materials consulting, occupational hygiene or a closely related field.
* A current LAA licence is essential.
* A current Australian driver’s licence is essential.
* Science, environmental or hazardous materials qualifications, including relevant P\-Certs, are desirable.
* Professional membership with AIOH, FAMANZ or a similar industry body will be highly regarded.
* Demonstrated experience preparing and reviewing technical reports.
* Experience managing projects, developing scopes and preparing fee proposals will be highly regarded.

**About you**  

* Strong asbestos and/or Occ Hygiene background \- Technically strong and confident providing advice to clients, contractors and other consultants.
* Comfortable balancing hands\-on fieldwork with reporting, project management and technical review.
* Well organised and capable of managing multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
* Able to communicate clearly and professionally with a broad range of stakeholders.
* Confident mentoring and providing constructive technical feedback to other consultants.
* Practical, safety\-focused and detail\-oriented.
* Able to work independently while contributing positively to the wider team.

If you are an experienced hazardous materials professional looking for a senior role that combines fieldwork, project ownership and technical leadership, apply now to join the Kiwa ELS team.
